breakfast.name: Nasi Kuning (Indonesian Yellow Rice)
breakfast.description: Traditional Indonesian yellow rice infused with turmeric, coconut milk, and aromatic spices. Often served with perkedel potato fritters and other accompaniments for breakfast or special occasions
instructions: Rinse rice thoroughly under cold water
Heat oil in pot and sauté garlic, ginger, and galangal for 1-2 minutes until fragrant
Add turmeric and stir for 30 seconds
Add rice and stir for 1 minute to coat with oil and spices
Pour in coconut milk and water, stirring well
Add lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and salam leaves
Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low
Cover and cook for 15-20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed
Remove from heat and let rest covered for 5 minutes
Remove lemongrass and leaf aromatics before serving
Fluff with fork and serve warm
breakfast.notes: Salam leaves and other aromatics are important for authentic Indonesian flavor. Often served with perkedel and other accompaniments
breakfast.fun_fact: Nasi kuning is often served for special occasions including weddings, birthdays, and independence day due to its perceived favorable fortune and auspicious meaning

breakfast.name: Perkedel (Indonesian Potato Fritters)
breakfast.description: Golden Indonesian potato fritters seasoned with garlic and nutmeg, traditionally served alongside nasi kuning and other breakfast items as part of tumpeng spread
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender (about 20 minutes), drain well
Peel potatoes while warm and mash until smooth
Heat butter and sauté minced garlic until fragrant (about 1 minute)
Add to mashed potatoes with eggs, nutmeg, black pepper, and salt
Mix thoroughly until smooth consistency
Spread flour on plate
Drop 1/4 cup batter portions onto flour
Using two forks, roll each portion to coat in flour, then shape into oval patties
Heat 2 inches of oil in deep pot to 350°F
Carefully place perkedel in hot oil
Fry 3-4 minutes total, turning halfway through, until golden brown
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
Serve hot with nasi kuning and other breakfast items
breakfast.notes: Russet potatoes are preferred because of their higher starch content. Proper oil temperature is crucial for achieving golden exterior without greasy interior
breakfast.fun_fact: Perkedel are authentic Indonesian snacks usually served alongside nasi kuning. They are often filled with potato, minced meat, corn, tofu, or fish depending on region

lunch.name: Nasi Goreng (Indonesian Fried Rice)
lunch.description: Daily lunch in Indonesia - fried rice with sweet soy sauce, eggs and vegetables. Every household has unique variation
instructions: Heat wok, add oil and garlic/shallots, fry 1 minute
Add protein, cook until done
Push to side, scramble eggs, mix in
Add chilled rice, breaking up clumps, stir-fry 3 minutes
Add vegetables, kecap manis and fish sauce
Toss everything 2-3 minutes until heated through
Serve with fresh cilantro and lime
lunch.notes: Rice must be day-old and chilled to avoid clumping. Sweet soy sauce is essential for authentic flavor
lunch.fun_fact: Nasi Goreng is daily lunch in Indonesia, every household and restaurant has own unique variation with local preferences

dinner.name: Indonesian Beef Rendang (Slow-Cooked Beef in Spiced Coconut Reduction)
dinner.description: Slow-cooked beef in spiced coconut reduction - Sumatra's iconic dinner
ingredients: 1kg beef chuck or sirloin, cut into 3cm cubes
instructions: Blend onions, garlic, ginger, galangal, chilies, turmeric into smooth paste
Blend candlenuts into paste separately
Heat oil in large heavy pot; add spice paste, cook 10 minutes stirring often
Add beef; brown on all sides (5-7 minutes)
Add cinnamon, cardamom, star anise, lemongrass; fry 2 minutes
Add coconut milk and candlenut paste; stir well
Bring to boil then reduce to very low simmer
Add kaffir lime leaves
Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 hours
Sauce thickens and darkens; oil will separate
Stir in kerisik (toasted coconut) if using
Taste and adjust salt
dinner.notes: Longer cooking develops flavors and improves with storage
dinner.fun_fact: Originated as ceremonial Minangkabau dish for weddings

dinner.name: Soto Ayam (Golden Turmeric Chicken Soup)
dinner.description: Indonesian aromatic chicken soup - comfort in a bowl
instructions: Toast coriander and cumin seeds in dry pan until fragrant (1 minute), grind
Heat oil in large pot
Add onions, garlic, ginger, cook until fragrant (2 minutes)
Add turmeric powder, toasted coriander, toasted cumin
Cook 1 minute
Add chicken pieces, cook 5 minutes to sear
Add chicken stock, galangal, lemongrass, bay leaves
Bring to boil, then reduce to gentle simmer
Cover and simmer 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through
Remove chicken, let cool slightly, then shred or cube meat
Return chicken to pot
Add potatoes and carrots
Simmer 15 minutes until vegetables are tender
Season with salt and pepper
Remove galangal, lemongrass, bay leaves
Serve in bowls garnished with fresh cilantro and fried shallots
Traditionally served with rice, hard-boiled eggs, and sambal
dinner.notes: The soup's golden color and warmth make it perfect comfort food
dinner.fun_fact: Soto Ayam is eaten throughout Indonesia for breakfast, lunch, or dinner
